correctness.rationale: For each m>=1 and h>0, differentiation of degree-2m equispaced Lagrange cardinal polynomials yields weights alpha_{m,j}=(-1)^(j+1)(m!)^2/[j(m-j)!(m+j)!] on paired +/-jh nodes. The beta-integral identity a_{m,j}=binom(m,j)*int_0^1 t^m(1-t)^(j-1)dt gives sum_j a_{m,j}=H_m/2 after substituting s=1-t. Therefore the l_infinity sampled-input norm is exactly 2sum|alpha|/h=H_m/h; aligned signs independently attain it. Independently reconstructed exact rational weights and every polynomial moment through degree 2m for m=1..20, all passed. This is not a stochastic-noise, nonuniform-grid, or floating-point-weight computation result.
